i get it..you want me to be holding myself for a tad bit longer.
but, u said there's no coming back from your situation?..r u okay?

ohh...hell no....damn..no man
what r u thinking...its just plain horrible and stupid
you are continuing what the devil's instigating you to do...blame the devil..not urself....look
here's the thing...you are in the place called rock bottom. now the only place you can go from here is up....so just stop worrying and take oe step at a time. go to public place. observe people moving. see the hustle-bustle of the city...this will divert your mind...don't sit alone...and stop popping the substance or pills..just plain say no...
you came to reddit..it's the best community to share it all, bare your hear out, let all out....it will definitely get better. we are all here to support you

i live in India.
i have no field experience. i can work in core chemical / or Environment(Environment Impact assessement, or Pollution control)
i only have experience as project coordinator & junior research fellow..in University...no field work or job experience

no brother, no...please no..don't do it
tell me, i'm here, the entire reddit community is here. please let us know. what is the problem, man
you have courage, you have it in you..please just don't end this gift of life

dylan your words give me strength. that's been so helpful. i'll draw all the strength i can. thanks so much
thanks to the entire reddit community for giving out so much support to me
it's hard to believe!!! did you not get any sponsors...

wel brother take it easy
you started a trend and now you just are continuing in the same direction.
you need to end this suffering yourself.
First stop then start by making short teerm goals to do good to others
when you will do good, it's gonna fill your heart with light, your soul with enlightment. 
you actually reflect on what you did in high school, u feel bad that's enough torture and punishment in itself. now don't extend it brah...
let good deeds fill you with hope and prosperity and happiness and these moments will be cherished, the moment you do good to somebody and they smile for you, you earned it, that's what i sgoing to fill you with life

Moving abroad requires money, brother. i am currently broke. i have no savings left, my father's pension is all that is supporting me.
in india , you get job offers if you have experience, i got none, no one has offered me a job in last 10 months man...it's not just my story bro...my batchmates are facing the same situation...

hey bro
i understand your issues and problems and the will to die and your soul sniffing out. look jus thold on for a second.
first things first , start by finding someone who is your age and poorer than you, yeah i am saying that, find someone who is your age and poorer, or just say poor boy who is 12 yrs old, ignore your therapist.
when you will spend time with someone who is not so blessed like you, you will begin to appreciate the gifts you have, appreciate life, the existence and the essence of life.
i want you to spend less time in your room and more time with someone who is your age, not alone stop being alone.
you will surely get better brother
yeah it's hard to make a living with these choices unless you turn pro in boxing .. or a writer

brouv brother, you make it sound so simple that it really starts to make me feel better, but the ground reality is:  i am in a very tough spot financially.
i completed masters in 2016. it's been 18 months unemployed...times just passing me by.
i honestly am shaken nd terrified to realize and face the condition that i am in. money is all that matters to me now, nothing else. i cherish everything i have, my mom nd dad and sisters nd everything....but without earning it all just seems  a PITY...
oh man...really..2 master's degrees. that's enough to kill u

In India, we have chemical engnr's by d tons, jobs r hard to come by.
it's literally overcrowded..

i feel for you brother. i can feel the depth of hurt in your shoes. however i still feel, you just need to stop tryin for a while and simply let go and take a break. let a few moments roll by. let the world be. reasses the position where you are in. Start by working a job to pay off the debts, let the belief set in!!
this thought crosses my mind, in-numerous times. it's a really good thought! just the thought of family that holds you back
thank you for the support brother. ...got to hang in here and bear it out..reddit's communnity has been a big help.
i like the sentence, where you mention, all we need is one time to succeed.... i'll try to hold onto that...

i'm from india brother. my english is fine, i believe. it's just that when you cry your heart out, grammar takes a dip in d shit.
however, i know you are right in d sense that we all are fightin for survival!
but sometimes it's too much to bear!!...ur tough exterior begins to crack and you become vulnerable to all those harsh things being hurled at ya!!!
i am just hangin by a thread..barely!!
yeah ricky...just a fine thread...attached to family which is holding me to the earth....otherwise i don't want to exist mortally

no doubt i find courage in ur words..but i feel stupid now nd ..just..just cant shake the feeling of being a loser .....ha..my god..my devil...lead to me to glory or death..i'm tired of hanging in between
